rule: Only the accounts below may start, or re-run, a job that can sign and publish the trust root. Matched by numeric GitHub user id, never by login. Enforced by .github/actions/production-dispatcher-check as the first step of every such job; scripts/check-production-dispatcher.mjs --verify-workflows (publish-trust-root.yml's validate job) fails the build if a protected job lacks it. Adding a person is a reviewed change to this file plus a DECISION_LEDGER entry in atlasent-internal.

dispatchers.basis: Founder and AtlaSent's one accountable human (DECISION_LEDGER 2026-10-02). Every trust-root publish so far was hers; this file makes that a check instead of a habit.
